title: diploma
summary: A diploma project studying neural-network approaches to imputing survey (questionnaire) data, including GAN-based imputation and synthetic training-set generation with descriptive analysis. One notebook fits SDV's GaussianCopulaSynthesizer and CTGANSynthesizer on the data and calls sdv.evaluation.single_table.evaluate_quality to score the results.
needs: Second notebook (data_generation) has identical SDV imports fully commented out; only Gain_imputation notebook demonstrates a live call.
